messages:
deploy-bot: rollout v3.7.2 -> prod(us-west) complete. triggered postdeploy smoke: prefill, kv-warmup, synth-chat. watch window 30m. :rocket:

alice.m: seeing a failing prefill-consistency check, only hitting edge-host-12. small sample: 2/10 seeds mismatched. no 5xx in gateway. :thinking_face:

dave.r: can you paste the probe payload + response? thinking cache prefix vs tokenizer mismatch.

alice.m: payload snippet:
```
POST /internal/prefill HTTP/1.1
Host: edge-host-12
{
  "seed": 42,
  "prompt": "Prefill test"
}
```
response: 200 but body tokens diverged from baseline on step 3.

carla_sre: any p95 latency or error spikes in probe timeline? if it’s only content mismatch maybe model variant skew or quantization edge-case.

alice.m: p95 ~ 120ms for that host, similar to green hosts. KV warmup log shows one WARN: `kv-cache: miss after prefill` at t+0.2s.

bob_oncall: this smells like a warmup ordering race. fallback plan: pin traffic for us-west to v3.7.1 and hold other regions. can someone confirm we can pin quickly? :eyes: 

dave.r: I can apply a routing pin. alternate: bump prefill concurrency and retrigger warmup on that host, see if mismatch clears. which is lower risk?

alice.m: bumping prefill is low-risk, but pinning buys time while we verify. prefer pin + warmup attempt.

emily_pm: add note to release notes: postdeploy smoke found localized prefill divergence on us-west edge-host-12, mitigation in progress. leaving change window open.

infra-bot: probe-job started job-8712 for target=edge-host-12 tests=[prefill,kv-warmup] by alice.m

alice.m: ran warmup retry (`/infra warmup edge-host-12 --concurrency=4`) — second probe now shows 9/10 seeds matching, one small token off (diff attached).

carla_sre: partial improvement. not fully resolved. could be nondeterministic quant path. we should pin traffic while we root cause. recommend pin to v3.7.1 for us-west and set alert for content-regression on prefills.

dave.r: applying pin now.

deploy-bot: routing change: pinned service:inference-us-west -> model v3.7.1 (rule id: pin-2026-1765). reverting rollout for us-west traffic only. :white_check_mark:

bob_oncall: thanks — monitoring. start 30m watch; if content-regression persists after warmup, escalate to rollback and open incident.

emily_pm: updating release notes and PR with the pin rationale. I'll add action items for model team to investigate quant path nondeterminism.

alice.m: copying logs/trace to #eng-ml for deeper analysis. link: https://logs.internal/trace/8712 (private)

carla_sre: also adding a synthetic test variant that seeds multiple RNGs to catch this nondeterminism in CI.

bob_oncall: for the record: no global rollback yet. holding rollout in us-west only. notify @oncall-after-hours if alerts fire. :alarm_clock:

deploy-bot: postdeploy summary: us-west pinned -> v3.7.1, warmup retried, probe improvement to 90%+, watch window set 30m. next update due at 1765440188.

alice.m: ack. will post final after watch. :thumbsup:
